words: The leading security is ticker VUG. Of its 920 in-kind receipts on 2026-04-21 (the IC|RO rows that round 121 counted), 30 accounts show a same-day quantity fall in another security, and none of those 30 falls matches its receipt value within 1 percent or within 5 percent. Under the stated rule the verdict is CONVERSION_LEG_ABSENT: the custodian feed does not carry a same-day delivery leg of matching value for the receipts. The 30 falls sit in five securities, by accounts: IDVZ 12, IEFA 6, DIVZ 4, SPYM 4, VEA 4. Four receipt accounts also carry an IC row on another security that day. Across all flagged accounts, 12 changed pairs have no same-day row in the feed: 10 are in NVDA and 2 in VGSH. The position file carries no description column, so this read cannot say whether a mutual-fund share class is held on 2026-04-20 in these accounts. For the guard: CONVERSION_LEG_ABSENT would mean the receipts are FLOW_UNRECONCILED with reason CONVERSION_LEG_ABSENT, because the feed lacks the delivery leg; an exchange rule would need a never-widen pair that counts the served delta per account-day, which this read does not propose. No guard change is proposed or made.
